title: Teacher observation
intro: Fill it in gradually, one area at a time. Nothing has to be completed at once.

next.title: What to look for next
next.intro: Questions from the latest AI suggestion. They are ideas, not conclusions.

empty.title: No teacher observation yet
empty.body: Start when you are ready. You can fill in one area at a time and come back later.

header.title: Child details
header.name: Child's name
header.periodOrder: The period ends before it starts.
header.closeBody: A closed observation is kept exactly as it is and can no longer be changed. You can start a reassessment later.
header.closedNote: This observation was closed on {date} and is kept as it was.
header.reassessBody: A new observation starts. The earlier one stays as it was.
header.copyForward: Start from the earlier answers (you can change them)

guide.title: How to observe
guide.notDiagnostic: A tool for educational observation and planning. It is not a medical or clinical diagnosis.

domain.readOnly: This observation is closed, so this area is read-only.

sensory.effectFor: {item}: how does it affect the child?

strengths.custom: Write it in my own words

needs.max: You can mark up to 3 areas.
